items.title: Trilegal advises Pixxel on $100 million Series C fundraise
items.summary: Bengaluru-based space startup Pixxelspace India Private Limited has raised $100 million from a Series C fundraise co-led by Temasek and Seraphim, with participation from both new and existing investors. Trilegal advised Pixxel on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Abhishek Dubey (Partner), with support from Ishita Sinha (Counsel) and Associates Sagnik Sarkar and Aditya Kaushik. Abhishek Dubey Pixxel is a deep-tech space company that specialises in the distribution of hyperspectral imagery and operates a constellation of six of the world’s highest resolution, commercial-grade hyperspectral earth observation satellites known as the 'Firefly' constellation. This is the single-largest funding round raised by a space technology company in India, taking Pixxel's total funding to $195 million. items.title: JSA advises NaBFID, Axis Bank, PTC India FinServ on financing for telecommunications infrastructure project
items.summary: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development, Axis Bank Limited and PTC India Financial Services Limited are financing a telecommunications infrastructure project undertaken by Space World Digital Solutions Private Limited and its subsidiary P2P Networks Private Limited. JSA Advocates and Solicitors advised NaBFID, Axis Bank, PTC India FinServ on this financing transaction. The transaction was led by Karan Mitroo (Partner), with support from Purvi Dabbiru (Partner), Aishwarya Dixit (Principal Associate), Samarth Sharma (Principal Associate), Associates Harshil Kakkar Riddhi Sri and Vristi Garg. The project comprises high-speed, ultra-low-latency, multi-path resilient optic fibre cable (OFC) networks and related digital infrastructure to enable seamless data centre-to-data centre (DC-to-DC) connectivity across identified routes by Space World Digital Solutions.
